analogy.rationale: Glucosidase inhibitors target digestive and lysosomal enzymes (MGAM, GAA, GANAB) that are not coupled to transcriptional programs in these cell lines, so they should elicit little or no mRNA response; the closest analogs are other enzyme inhibitors with similarly peripheral or non-transcriptional targets.
